function.name: cmd_controller_execute
function.description: Executes a system-level command using os.system() on Windows operating systems. It can execute single or multiple commands chained with '&&'. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

command.description: The system command to be executed. To execute multiple commands, separate them with '&&'. For example, 'dir && echo done'.

unit.description: Specifies the unit of measure for the command if applicable. This is not utilized by os.system() directly but can be used for logging or analysis purposes.

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to capture images directly from your device. However, you can take a photo yourself using your phone’s camera app or a webcam on your computer. If you need help with the steps or want to know how to share the photo with me, just let me know!
message.reasoning: The user says "take a pic of me". They want to take a picture. We have a tool to execute system commands. But we cannot actually take a picture. We can instruct them how to do it. Or we can simulate? The user might be expecting us to use the tool to run a command like "capture image" but that's not possible. We can respond that we can't take a picture. We can provide instructions. So we should respond politely that we cannot take a picture.
